text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Her speed doesn't dull in the slightest, even in the final stretch.
What incredible legs.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, well yeah♪ My Trainer gave me
some advice on how to improve my form!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Keep your upper body stable so you don't lose speed!
That's how you maintain top speed.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Trainer, you really
think a lot about the races for me.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, what a huge mountain of books!
Are you going to read all of these!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"The Fastest Training Method for Milers",
"Mastering the Mile! 50 Tips for Improvement"...
Whoa, they're all about the mile!
choice_data_list: After all, you're aiming for the very top of the mile division.
After all, what you're aiming for is the very pinnacle of the mile.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
choice_data_list: I need to study a lot more about mile races, too!
I need to study a lot more about mile races, too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I've met someone who cares for their trainee Umamusume more than anyone else... There could truly be nothing more wonderful than this.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! If I'm with you, Trainer,
I can even become the world's strongest miler!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing my errand and returning to the track,
I saw Gran Alegria and the others talking.
choice_data_list: What are you two talking about?
What are you two talking about?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
All right, last hill dash rep!
Let's give it everything we've got~!
